diagnostics.message: :resource.local_file.public_ssh_key declares `depends_on = ["tls_private_key.ssh"]`, but its `content` is `${tls_private_key.ssh.public_key_openssh}`, which already creates an implicit dependency on :resource.tls_private_key.ssh. The explicit depends_on duplicates an ordering Terraform already derives from the attribute reference and can be dropped.

:resource.local_file.private_ssh_key declares `depends_on = ["tls_private_key.ssh"]`, but its `content` is `${tls_private_key.ssh.private_key_pem}`, which already creates an implicit dependency on :resource.tls_private_key.ssh. The explicit depends_on is redundant and can be removed.
